CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE recalc_market_impact_cost()
LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $$
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO market_impact_cost_log (ordersmark, mic)
    SELECT o.recordvault, o.notionsum * sm.mkteffect
    FROM orders o, systemmonitoring sm
    WHERE o.orderflow = 'New'
    AND sm.systemmonitoringpivot = (SELECT MAX(systemmonitoringpivot) FROM systemmonitoring);
END;
$$;
